# pangolin_virtual_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists the manual virtual API keys (AI gateway) of the organization. The list never carries the secret; only its last four characters are returned, to tell keys apart.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keys that may call one public resource. The secret is never listed.
data "pangolin_virtual_api_keys" "for_resource" {
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.llm.id
}

output "key_names" {
  value = [for k in data.pangolin_virtual_api_keys.for_resource.virtual_api_keys : k.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `resource_id` (Number) Only return keys that may call this public resource (including keys allowed on all resources).
- `search` (String) Only return keys whose name, description or last characters contain this text (case-insensitive).
- `user_id` (String) Only return keys bound to this user ID.

### Read-Only

- `virtual_api_keys` (Attributes List) List of virtual API keys, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_api_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `all_resources` (Boolean) Whether the key may call every public inference resource.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation timestamp (epoch milliseconds).
- `description` (String) The key description, or `null`.
- `expires_at` (Number) Expiry (epoch milliseconds), `null` if it never expires.
- `id` (String) The virtual API key ID.
- `last_chars` (String) The last four characters of the secret.
- `last_used_at` (Number) Last use (epoch milliseconds), `null` if never used.
- `name` (String) The key name, or `null`.
- `resource_ids` (List of Number) IDs of the resources the key may call (empty when `all_resources` is true).
- `user_id` (String) The user the key is bound to, or `null`.
